summary: After an RPM install, make automation controller jobs use the egress proxy by setting AWX_TASK_ENV (http_proxy, https_proxy, no_proxy) in Extra Environment Variables under Settings > Automation Execution > Job; containerized installs don't need this.
questions: How do I make automation controller jobs use a proxy?
Where do I set AWX_TASK_ENV for http_proxy?
Do containerized installs need AWX_TASK_ENV proxy settings?
Jobs can't reach the internet through the proxy

answer_card.title: Proxy for controller jobs (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
**Settings > Automation Execution > Job** > Edit > *Extra Environment Variables*:
```json
"AWX_TASK_ENV": {
  "http_proxy": "http://external-proxy_0:3128",
  "https_proxy": "http://external-proxy_0:3128",
  "no_proxy": "localhost,127.0.0.0/8"
}
```
Not needed for containerized installs: Podman uses the system proxy.
